findings.title: Search Results Page Missing Sorting
findings.details: The SearchPage component does not offer sorting options (price asc/desc, popularity, newest). Users cannot sort search results.

findings.title: Search Results Page Missing Price & Facet Filters
findings.details: SearchPage only displays raw search matches and category chips; it lacks sidebar or drawer filters for price range, brands, or stock availability.

findings.title: Hard Window Reload on Price Filter Application
findings.details: applyPriceFilter executes `window.location.href = ...` causing a full browser reload and DOM reconstruction rather than client-side router navigation.

findings.title: Stock Indicator Not Visible
findings.details: No clear stock badge found on product detail page.

findings.title: No Variant Switching or Sizing Options in Cart Drawer
findings.details: CartDrawer does not display selected variant attributes and provides no dropdown or modal to switch size/color inside the cart before checkout.

findings.title: No Payment Method Choice at Checkout
findings.details: Checkout page lacks payment method selection (Cash on Delivery vs Credit/Debit Card vs Birkart/Kapital installment). Customers are unilaterally forced into Cash on Delivery.

findings.title: No Delivery Method Selection
findings.details: Checkout does not permit choosing between Courier Home Delivery, Express 2-hour Delivery, or In-Store Pickup.

findings.title: Language Switcher Drops Query Parameters
findings.details: Switching languages from /az to /ru or /en drops active filters (?brand=Apple) and resets the user view because LocaleSwitcher only splits pathname.
